config.design: Fit log scalar gain from first12 H769 probes on32 training documents. Fixed ridge.1 and no selection. Train-standardize activation inputs; exponentiate predictions and calibrate arithmetic mean on training only. Evaluate gain and12targetcurvatures on16 separate validation documents. Baseline PCA and centering fitted on original training data only.
config.limitations: Small reused validation panel; no output/model probes needed for predictor inference, but labels came from probes. Target-probe prediction is not actual finite KL or causal fidelity. No learned featurizer evaluated.
